name: Aromat
source:
This is a simple story about young people, about the aroma of youth and the smells of life, which can so easily be cut short by a fatal accident. Or maybe at the behest of a heartless fate.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159300/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于年轻人的简单故事，关于青春的芬芳与生活的气息，而这一切，却可能轻易被一场致命的意外截断。又或许，那是无情命运的安排。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159300/]Steam[/url]]
